query:
UPDATE waitlist_applications SET (id, 
name, 
email, 
link_1, 
link_2, 
link_3, 
note, 
invitation_id, 
status, 
review_notes, 
created_at, 
reviewed_at) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE name END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE email END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE link_1 END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE link_2 END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE link_3 END), (CASE $14::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $15 ELSE note END), (CASE $16::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $17 ELSE invitation_id END), (CASE $18::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $19 ELSE status END), (CASE $20::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $21 ELSE review_notes END), (CASE $22::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $23 ELSE created_at END), (CASE $24::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $25 ELSE reviewed_at END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
name as "name!: String", 
email as "email!: String", 
link_1 as "link_1!: String", 
link_2 as "link_2!: String", 
link_3 as "link_3!: Option < String >", 
note as "note!: String", 
invitation_id as "invitation_id!: Option < i32 >", 
status as "status!: WaitlistApplicationStatus", 
review_notes as "review_notes!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
reviewed_at as "reviewed_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >"
